# Berat Yanardağ

> Berat Yanardağ is an Computer Programming student in Antalya working on web interfaces and motion graphics. This is a bilingual (Turkish/English) personal portfolio site.
> Berat Yanardağ, Antalya'da Bilgisayar Programcılığı okuyan; web arayüzü ve hareketli grafik üzerine çalışan bir öğrencidir.

## English
- [Home](https://www.example.com/en/): introduction, featured projects, gallery preview
- [About](https://www.example.com/en/about.html): CV, class schedule, interests, skills
- [Projects](https://www.example.com/en/projects.html): Graphic Animation I course pieces
- [Blog](https://www.example.com/en/blog.html): posts on building a 3D site with AI, a backend-free contact form, designing a web interface in Photoshop
- [Gallery](https://www.example.com/en/gallery.html): fifteen photos with short captions
- [Contact](https://www.example.com/en/contact.html): address, phone, email and contact form
